title: Locate and fix a crash reported only by its symptom
prompt: Bug report from support: "Generating a sales report with no filters selected crashes with 'ZeroDivisionError'. Adding any filter makes it work again." Reproduce it, find the responsible code, and fix it so a report with no filters is generated over the full dataset. Empty-result reports must also be handled: report a share of 0.0 rather than crashing. Keep every other reporting behaviour unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: build_report succeeds when the filter list is empty, covering all records.
build_report succeeds when filters match no records, reporting zero totals and 0.0 shares.
Category shares still sum to 1.0 (within floating-point tolerance) when there is data.
Existing filtering, sorting and formatting behaviour is unchanged.
The fix is made in the module actually responsible, not worked around at the call site.
